api_design: POST /api/residents/{resident_id}/chat JSON with optional attachments[]; images use data_base64; text snippets use text.
fallback_behavior: When no local vision model exists, image is stored and Alfred truthfully reports visual inspection is unavailable.
forget_redaction_behavior: forget_conversation redacts text/response, suppresses turns from normal history, marks attachment redaction_status, and removes attachment summaries.
known_limitations: Vision model detection uses local Ollama name hints
Browser paste depends on clipboard APIs
local_vision_adapter_status: LocalVisionAdapter uses local Ollama only; no cloud vision APIs.
local_vision_status: No local vision-capable model discovered in this environment.
pull_request_not_applicable_reason: PR will be created with make_pr after the local git commit as required by the Codex handoff.
recommended_next_action: Install/configure a local vision-capable Ollama model and run the Steward-local smoke test.
summary: Implemented local-first pasted image/text attachments for Alfred resident chat with bounded storage, UI paste handling, safe history thumbnails, local vision adapter boundary, truthful fallback, tests, report, and validation recipe.
tests_run: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests/test_resident_conversation_sessions.py tests/test_resident_authority.py tests/test_resident_interaction.py tests/test_steward_command_center.py -q
ui_changes: Added paste capture, pending attachment display/removal, JSON attachment send, and history attachment rendering.
ui_paste_behavior: Alfred textarea paste handler captures clipboard images and long text snippets, shows pending attachments, allows removal, sends text plus attachments, and reloads history with metadata and safe thumbnails.
